releases.notes:
Mostly bug fixes.

## Forever
- **Loot Window:** To address a conflict with the game, Plumber Loot Window will now be automatically disabled if you are the Loot Master in a group.
- **Handy Lockpick:** This module has been re-enabled on Forever, allowing you to right-click a lockbox in your bag or the Trade UI to unlock it.
  - Note: We don't have any rogues to verify this feature on Forever, though the underlying system should be identical to modern WoW.

## Nameplate: Soft Target
- **Quest Objectives:** This should now only display your own quest (instead of your teammates') objective progress when you are in a group.
- **Platynator:** Our radial cast bar should now correctly align to the center of [Platynator](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/platynator)'s Soft Interact Icon and hide its icon when you start casting.

## 12.1.7
- **Expansion Summary, Powers** Fixed a visual issue where the 2 newly added Omnium Folio traits overlapped with the card's label.

- **WoW Anniversary:** The quick slot for the Mount Maniac event can be enabled again.
- **Forever:** Fixed the last issue (hopefully) with the Transmog UI module.

---
Previous Changelog
- **Transmog UI: Restore Pending Changes:** This module works again on Forever.
  - You should no longer see "Invalid Custom Set Link" in chat upon entering the game.
- **Drawer Macro:** It now respects spell ranks, and the rank will be shown on the drawer buttons.
- **Tooltip: Reagents:** This module is now available on Forever. If an item can be used to combine into something new, display all "reagents" used in the process.

- **Transmog UI: Restore Pending Changes:** This module works again on Forever.
  - You should no longer see "Invalid Custom Set Link" in chat upon entering the game.
- **Drawer Macro:** It now respects spell ranks, and the rank will be shown on the drawer buttons.
- **Tooltip: Reagents:** This module is now available on Forever. If an item can be used to combine into something new, display all "reagents" used in the process.

## Hunter: Pet Food Menu
- You can now click the Pet Happiness indicator to show a list of suitable foods, allowing you to easily feed your pet.
- This module is Forever-only.
- This module requires Blizzard's Pet Happiness Indicator (next to the PetFrame) to be visible.

## Miscellaneous
- For **Platynator** and Plumber users who have enabled **Nameplate: Soft Target**: Our radial cast bar on the Soft Target nameplate now aligns to the center of Platy's SoftTargetIcon, and will hide this icon when our cast bar appears.

- **Plumber Drawer Macro:** You can now drag other macros into the Drawer.
- Fixed an issue where the **Nameplate Quest Indicator** appeared on the left and inside the health bar when you set its position to the right.
- **Break Time Reminder:** It no longer treats house interiors and neighborhoods as "instances" and postpones the reminder.

---

Previous Changelog
- **Tooltip, Reputation Tokens:** This module now supports [Aqir Research Tokens](https://www.wowhead.com/item=286563/aqir-research-token), showing your renown progress on the vendor tooltip.
- **Auctionator and Loot UI:** The price info should appear on the Loot UI's item tooltip.
- **Loot UI on Classic:** Fixed an issue that caused the loot notification mode to stop working after a recent Plumber update.
- **Auto Select Holiday Dungeon:** This module has been enabled on MoP Classic.
